properties.name: A composed prompt serves the pieces it was composed from, and a replayed finding that has gone is refused distinguishably
properties.statement: Promoted 2026-09-20 on Anthony's word, under his black-box rule: a consumer must never have to read reflow2's prose to work. The prompt builder holds a finding's title and its why as separate values, joins them in one statement and returns only the joined string, so flo2 splits that string on a literal marker — the only place it breaches the rule. The pieces ride back beside the prompt. AND the second half, which the reporter found while complaining: their redundant re-computation of every finding per click is also how they refuse a stale one, so a VANISHED finding must refuse distinguishably — that removes the recomputation instead of making it cheaper to avoid, which taking a bare id would not.
